classes.name: Vagrant Mk.I
classes.description: An ageing light shuttle designed for short-range orbital and inter-system transfers. The Mk.I was the workhorse of Pell-Dyne's budget cargo line, produced in the tens of thousands through the 2240s and 2250s. Considered outdated even during production, the design prioritises repairability over performance — nearly every component can be replaced with standard parts. When Pell-Dyne collapsed during the Great Contraction, thousands of decommissioned Mk.Is flooded salvage markets across the outer systems. Most are still flying.
classes.lore: Fleet engineers nicknamed the Mk.I the 'Vagrant' before Pell-Dyne officially adopted the name. The O2 generator's characteristic three-beat rattle before failure is so well-known it has its own entry in the mechanics' slang dictionary.
